summary: Ignore integrated authorization snapshots on clean main

delivery.outcome: Clean integrated snapshots do not retain false coordination leases while every material change remains bound to one active owning ticket.
nonGoals: Do not rewrite tracked ticket histories after merge
Do not accept material changes without an active ticket
Do not treat unverified local prose as a terminal receipt

architecture.decision: Select coordination leases from tickets touched or claimed by the current diff; with no diff, retain the records as authorization history but project no live writer. Keep implementation authorization in the existing change gate.
architecture.rollback: Restore repository-wide active-record coordination; clean default-branch releases will again require an out-of-band workaround.

validation.evidence: Clean snapshots pass while integrated authorization carriers remain tracked.
Ambiguous active ownership fixtures retain exact diagnostics.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
validation.evidence: The complete deterministic hub contract passes before publication.
